2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-resource-usage-settlement and its input (the worked example shows one).

4. It reads nothing itself. You read the settlement or version row and its allocation rows (resource-usage-settlement, resource-usage-settlement-version, resource-usage-allocation) from your own store and hand them in as settlement and allocations; it pages them and keeps nothing.
